entities.name: Louise de Keroual, Duchess of Portsmouth
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louise Renée de Penancoët de Kérouaille, Duchess of Portsmouth was a French mistress of King Charles II of England. She was also made Duchess of Aubigny in the peerage of France.
